definition_ja: 帰無仮説が正しいとしたときに、各カテゴリ（分割表の各セル）に入ると見込まれる度数。
definition_en: The count that each category (or cell of a two-way table) would be expected to have if the null hypothesis were true.

examples.en: Check that every expected count is at least five before you use the chi-square test.
examples.ja: カイ二乗検定を使う前に、期待度数がすべて 5 以上か確かめる。

examples.en: Compute the expected frequency for each cell of the table.
examples.ja: 表の各セルの期待度数を計算せよ。

pitfalls: OpenStax Introductory Statistics は expected frequency、AP Statistics の CED（2026 年版）は expected count と書く。
期待値（expected value）とは別の語だが、OpenStax は式の説明で E = expected values とも書く。

sources.title: College Board, AP Statistics Course and Exam Description (Effective Fall 2026)
